operators.name: Angi
observations: 2025 filing lists paid and free search, social/display, affiliate agreements, offline TV/radio and retail partner relationships.
2025 US consumer marketing expense USD 323.470 million; distinct from calls purchased or customer acquisitions.
2025 customers sought pros for approximately 16 million projects; NOT a pay-per-call figure.

reported_indicators.limitations: Aggregate marketing expense, not cost of phone calls or Google Ads spend.
Projects for which consumers sought pros, not payable calls.

operators.name: QuinStreet
observations: Fiscal 2026 filing describes owned/accessed targeted media plus search/social/display purchases and large/small online publisher rev share.
Matches consumers to clients based on fit, response, conversion and economics.
Media/publisher costs can be revenue share, CPL, CPC or CPA; client payments tied to contract-qualified outcomes.

operators.name: Modernize Home Services
observations: Owns content websites, buys search/social/native, and works with publishers.
Call center validates consumer projects before some live transfers.
Affiliate programme pays per submitted roofing, HVAC, solar and other eligible lead; affiliates require approval.
Affiliate page self-reports connecting more than 25,000 homeowners weekly, not independently audited phone calls.

reported_indicators.limitations: Company claim about homeowner connections, not audited, not per-week pay-per-call volume.

operators.name: eLocal
observations: Accepts publisher traffic from search, social, display, native and offline with campaign rules.
Qualifies by caller category/geography via IVR, API or in-house call center and routes to local advertiser.

operators.name: Service Direct
observations: Public article describes lead sourcing from owned sites and outside publishers.
Historical self-reported search-heavy attribution; 85% figure is historical and not treated as a current channel mix.

operators.name: Aragon Advertising
observations: Describes vetted affiliate network, owned properties and internal media team supplying inbound calls.
Offers call-quality dispositions and specific campaign CPA goals.
Affiliate agreement process: applicant traffic review, vetted sources, matching, manager, qualified-call payouts.
Claims millions of calls delivered monthly on marketing page; no audited volume, date-specific count or payable-call breakdown.

operators.name: RingPartner
observations: Offers geo- and vertical-specific publisher campaigns, real-time reporting and manager-supported payout conditions.
Says hundreds of campaigns available; self-reported, not evidence of actual Empire-accessible offers.

operators.name: Marketcall
observations: Offers publisher templates, tracking, landing pages and callback tools; claims weekly partner payouts.
Marketing site claims 19,462,818 calls attracted cumulatively; undated/self-reported, not independently audited or attributable to roofing.

reported_indicators.limitations: Cumulative public marketing-counter figure, date and method not independently confirmed; not payable calls.

platform_and_policy_sources.evidence: RTB lets publishers request a bid; platform checks target availability and bid modifiers. This is routing/monetisation tech, not traffic acquisition.
Google Ads can measure calls by keyword and campaign with call conversion tracking; not proof of a sale.
Google Local Services Ads prohibit lead reselling and forwarding to unrelated businesses.
Doorway pages and scaled low-value content violate spam policies; no mass interchangeable ZIP pages.
